name: Fortify Timeline's heal applies Mark of Order (#2291)
contract: Mark of Order 704488's tooltip is "Healing done by Fortify Timeline now applies Mark of Order". Its only effect is aura 42 (SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL) on 806269, the Mark itself (SPELL_AURA_MOD_HEALING_RECEIVED +10 class-masked to Reverse Wound, 20 sec, StackAmount 5). Spell.dbc gives 704488 ProcFlags 0x0 and no spell_proc row existed, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skipped it and Aura::GetProcEffectMask returned 0: the Mark was never applied. Fortify Timeline is 804491 (SpellFamilyName 28, SpellFamilyFlags word1 4194304, DmgClass 1, effect 0 SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL at TARGET_UNIT_CASTER_AREA_RAID, which reaches the caster himself when ungrouped). This scenario covers only the application half of the issue: Mark of Order's own per-second stack growth is a separate defect (806270 carries its delta in MiscValueB while Spell::EffectAscensionModifyAuraStacks reads MiscValue), so no assertion is made on stack growth here.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
No Mark of Order before any cast
Fortify Timeline's heal applies Mark of Order to the healed unit
